spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation
 of the Chapter
 on the Wheel of the
 Stars

**
¶1.
** The great
 cycle
 of spiritual knowledges,
 which is now
 opened
 to the
 understanding, is a principal
 power
 among
 all
 the ord
erings of the inner
 life. It
 stands
 as one of four
 fundamental arrangements
, for
 the dominant love that governs all states
 of
 the mind
 is distributed
 across
 four distinct planes
.


**¶2.** The
 first plane
 comprises
 the spiritual
 forces that dwell in the successive interior
 degrees
 of the higher mind —
 those
 ten
 states
 of rational
 int
eriority that exist
 above the cycle
 of knowledges. The dominant
 love is
 bound fast
 within them
, held captive in
 those
 celestial states as
 though
 imprisoned
 in their
 very
 elevation
.

**¶3.**
 The second plane comprises
 the eight conditions
 of the external and natural mind that
 lie
 below:
 four
 being
 mixed
 states
,
 where
 good and fals
ity are
 comp
ounded together
, and four being
 states
 of pure falsity and
 spiritual
 darkness
. This
 second
 plane extends from the natural
 conscious mind, upon
 which the
 understanding
 walks
 in
 daily
 life, down
ward into the
 deep
est sensual and corporeal degrees
.

**¶4.**
 The third plane comprises the boundaries and the
 containing forms that en
close all the
 worlds
 of
 the
 mind
. These
 are four elevated
 states of love toward
 the Divine
,
 and three receiving
 forms of truth — together
 with
 all
 that
 they
 hold
 within
 themselves
,
 and the dominant love that is confined
 within those
 forms
,
 and the spiritual
 forces that exercise
 mas
tery over them.

**¶
5.** The fourth plane is
 the ordered cycle of spiritual knowledges
 itself
, arranged with the
 utmost provid
ential care according to a
 manif
old design
:
 proce
eding from the Divine principle
 of
 life
, and received
 through
 the faculty
 by
 which good is brought
 forth into
 living
 form
.

**¶6.**
 This
 cycle
 was
 ordered
 with such
 diligence because
 of the great and cruel forces
 of
 self
-love and
 the imm
ense hered
itary evils that
 are fast
ened to
 it,
 suspended
 from it
 as
 though hanging
 upon
 it
. For
 all
 the primary
 and most powerful evil
 loves —
 the first
born rulers
 from
 every
 degree
 of the mind's three
 planes — were gathered
 in
.
 They
 were collected, seized, bound fast
, and assigned to
 this cycle of
 knowledges. Each was apport
ioned out
 of
 those
 three planes. They were distributed among
 one
 another, entwined, and set
 in
 precise
 counterbalance — each evil weighted
 against its corresponding opposite of
 equal
 magnitude
.

**¶7.**
 And
 yet the
 cycle
 itself
 is equal in
 power to the
 hostile forces bound
 upon it. Indeed
, these
 forces of
 
enmity were suspended upon the ever
-turning
 cycle
 of
 kn
owledges precisely
 because of their destructive nature:
 so
 that, through
 the influx of spiritual life and the
 constant change of states in
 which they are carried
 round
, they cannot perceive or fix upon
 the condition
 in which they are held. For
 had
 they been fast
ened in the celest
ial states of
 the higher
 mind, those states would
 not have had
 the strength to bear
 them. And
 had they been assigned to
 the natural
 mind's fixed structures below
, neither
 could
 those
 structures
 have sustained
 them. Rather
, they were suspended in
 the perpetual turning
 of spiritual
 knowledges, so that the power
 and the
 wisdom
 ascending from the natural mind below
 could be received and conveyed up
ward to the celestial states above them
.
 Conversely, whatever desc
ends from the
 interior states —
 whether the cold
ness of absent
 charity or the heat
 of love
's
 fire — the cycle of
 knowledges also
 receives
 it and
 distrib
utes it throughout the entire
 natural mind and across
 all the
 mind
's perceptions.

**¶
8.**
 Behold, the ordering
 of this
 cycle is of
 this
 form.
 The
 hostile
 forces en
twined upon it are like this:
 a ruling
 love
 that masters
 the
 whole mind by
 means
 of a
 mighty array
 of all
 the subordin
ate governing
 principles — together
 with all the tru
ths arranged
 for spiritual
 combat that
 are gathered
 to it, and the accumulated
 goods and
 poss
essions of the inner
 life,
 and the all
uring aff
ections both
 pure and corrupt
 that
 are assembled
 before
 it,
 and the natural
 good affections that
 are distributed
 throughout
 its
 attend
ant
 states
.
 Yet if you inqu
ire into
 that ruling love itself
, it is precisely
 matched against the
 whole
 of
 its attending
 states. Its attending
 states, in
 turn, are matched against the
 entire
 domain
 of the
 mind. Judgment proceeds
 from it —
 vindication and condemnation — throughout
 the whole
 mind
, by its interior
 understanding, by
 its practical intelligence, and by the power
 of its
 good.

**¶9.
** Now, just as this
 ruling love is matched against the measure
 of its entire domain
 by understanding
, intelligence
, and the
 power of good,
 so also
 is it with
 the hostile forces bound upon the
 cycle
 of
 knowledges as
 compared with
 the dominant
 love and
 the forces
 that exist throughout
 the whole
 sphere
 of
 the mind. As
 the ruling love stands
 toward
 its attendant states, so does
 the
 tot
ality of spiritual
 life
 gather
 itself to the cycle — to
 seven primary
 governing principles, to twelve fundamental
 states encomp
assing all things of faith and charity in
 their completeness.
 As all doc
trinal systems are gathered under
 the ruling love, so they
 are
 gathered under
 the governing
 principles of the universal
 order
. All that is done in the mind
 above and below — the spiritual
 comb
ats, the confusions of thought,
 the bondages to evil, the dep
rivations of good, the cupid
ities, and the possessions of truth
 —
 all these increase
 and diminish through these governing principles.
 They are the active
 causes of every
 change in the whole
 regenerating mind,
 and all
 states
 are
 gathered
 into
 them in the manner
 I have disclosed
 to
 you.
 The
 interior
 sight
 of understanding
 has
 been opened.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The wheel of the stars, which is displayed to you, is a great mighty thing! Also, it is one among the four great things; since the whole ruling-power is assigned to four parts.
The first part is the powers who occur in the ten firmaments that exist above the wheel, and the ruling-power that is bound in them, as it is imprisoned within them in the heavens that are above.

The second part is the eight earths that are below; the four that are composite, and the four places of darkness. The second part extends from this earth, upon which mankind walks, towards the underside.

The third part is the walls and the vessels that surround the worlds. They are the four mountains and the three vessels; with what is in them, and the ruling-power that is trapped within them, and the powers who are masters over them.
The fourth part is the sphere of the stars that is appointed with great diligence, as it is ordered in a [great m]any [designs]; that of the Father of Life, [and that of the Mother of] the living.

Its [ordering was] very [carefully fashioned] with diligence, because of the great and cruel powers, and the titanic figures, [who are bound] in it; they being suspended from it. So, all the first-born and the leaders of all the rulers, they who were existing in the three parts, these were garnered. They were collected together, seized, bound and assigned on this wheel. Each was apportioned by these three parts. They were distributed, entwined, and weighted against their companions of the same size.

Still, for its part, the wheel is equal to them in its strength; the powers of the enmity who are bound on it. Indeed, they were suspended on the circling wheel because of their cruelty; so that, due to the wind and the motion in which they go round, they comprehend not the place wherein they are set. For if they had been bound in the heavens, the heavens would not have had the strength to support them. Again, if they had been assigned on the earths, on the fixtures that are below, they also would not have had the strength to support them. Rather, they were suspended from the wheel of the circling stars; so that the power and the light that should come up from below can be received, and given to the heavenly ones above them. Conversely, whatever will fall from above, whether cold or hot, the wheel of the sphere will also take it and cast it out upon the entire earth, upon all the wood.

Behold, the ordinance of the wheel is in this form. For the powers who are entwined on the wheel are like this: a king mastering his kingdom by this mighty legionary force of all the leaders of the kingdom; and with all the armour of the soldiery that is collected together for him; and also with the mass of the property of the kingdom; and the beautiful lustful aspect of the women who are collected together for him; together with [all the] property [of his lands,] and those cattle [and flocks] that have been distributed about among his retinue. Yet, if you ask about that king, he is matched with all his retinue. His retinue, for its part, is matched against his entire kingdom. Judgement shall come forth from him, vindication and condemnation, to his entire kingdom; by his wisdom, skill and strength.

Now, just as for this king, who is matched against the measure of his entire kingdom by his wisdom, skill and strength; so also is it for the powers who are bound on the sphere as compared to the ruling-power, and the powers who exist in the entire zone. Like the king towards his retinue; so too is it that this totality is gathered to the sphere, to seven leaders, to twelve signs of the zodiac. As all the cities are gathered to the king, again they gather to the leaders of the universe. All that is done in the universe above and below: the battles and the disorders and the captivity and the hunger and the lust and the property; so shall they increase and diminish through these leaders. They are the motivaters of the whole created order; the totality being gathered in to them the way that I have told you. I have opened your eyes!
